question: When I roughly know a Stellar docs page is called State Archival, what is the fastest precise way to find its canonical page before reading it?

golden.answer: Use search_doc_titles with the expected page title words. It returns one hit per page, ranked by query words in the page title and URL path. Check each hit's title and path to choose the canonical page, then read it with get_doc_page or a content-bearing docs search. Title search is page-level discovery and should not be treated as full-body research.
keyFacts: Uses page-level title search to locate pages by their expected name.
Follows the selected hit's path with a page-reading operation.
avoid: Do NOT claim title hits contain the complete page body.
Do NOT choose a result solely from a snippet word without checking its title and path.
golden.notes: Live docs title-discovery behavior; exact hit ordering may drift.
